_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.title: Goal next-action chaining
requirements.description: The system should compute one recommended next action per goal, chaining into the top-priority member item's next action when no goal-level decision is pending

validation.notes: No coverage yet: goal-level next-action chaining is not implemented — there is no per-goal recommended-next-action logic in internal/goals. Only item-level next_action_test.go and swarm-level operations/briefing_test.go exist (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Goal progress and velocity
requirements.description: The system should report per-goal progress, ETA bands, scope-creep history, and completion velocity against the goal's trajectory

validation.notes: TestService_CreateComputesScopeAndBaseline (per-goal progress %), TestService_AttachesETABand (per-goal ETA band), TestService_ScopeCreepRecordedOnDrift (scope-creep history). Completion velocity against the goal's trajectory is NOT tested per-goal (audit 2026-07-23).
TestEstimateGoal_P50NotAboveP80, TestEstimateGoal_MoreCapacityShortensBand, and TestEstimateGoal_BasisReportsSampleCount back the ETA-band math and confidence labeling.

requirements.title: Goal-scoped discovery
requirements.description: When goal discovery runs, the system should identify missing or at-risk work inside the goal's scope and propose backlog items to close the gaps

validation.notes: No coverage yet: goal-scoped discovery (identify missing/at-risk work in a goal's scope and propose backlog items) has no test. Only a 'goal.discover' transition fixture exists in the registry; no behavior test exercises it (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Swarm management sessions
requirements.description: The system should provide conversational agent sessions primed with an operator-loop skill that can drive the full create, workshop, accept, execute, review cycle

validation.notes: TestServiceStartSwarmOperationsUsesOperationsSkillAndPurpose (session primed with the operator-loop skill) and TestServiceStartInitialPromptDeliversFullSkill. The full create/workshop/accept/execute/review cycle is not asserted end-to-end in one test (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: One-shot execution strategy
requirements.description: The system should offer a one-shot full-plan execution strategy alongside the phased drain in the strategy registry

validation.notes: No coverage yet: a one-shot / full-plan execution strategy is not implemented — the registry declares only phased-plan-drain and TestStrategies_ReturnsDeclaredExecutionChoiceWithCost asserts exactly one strategy (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Live execution progress
requirements.description: While an execution runs, the system should surface live slice progress, workflow state, and cancellation controls

validation.notes: TestWorkflowServiceProgressReadsLiveTrace (live slice count, current node, cost from the workflow trace), TestGenericWorkflowCommandResultAndControlSurface (signal/cancel controls), TestWorkflowServiceCollectsCanceledCompletion (surfaces cancelled terminal state).

requirements.title: Unified work activity feed
requirements.description: The system should present one per-item feed spanning runs, reviews, proposals, operator decisions, and status changes

validation.notes: TestHandlerList_FiltersAgentActivities (per-item feed retrieval/filter); service TestServiceListRefreshesActiveRunState, TestListReconcilesWorkflowActivityFromWorkflowExecution, and TestServiceStopRunCancelsActiveActivities cover runs, status changes, and operator stop.
TestLanes_ReturnsCanonicalOrdering groups run/review/reconcile activities into one lane view. 'Proposals' as a distinct feed item type is not asserted (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Execution policy modes
requirements.description: The system should enforce manual, scheduled, and yolo execution policies with configurable delays, queue caps, and circuit breakers

validation.notes: TestQueueDepthEnforcement (queue cap), TestCircuitBreakerBlocksQueue, TestYoloAtCapacity_LeavesPending; service TestQueueAndStartManualExecution and TestQueueBacklog_YOLORollsBackWhenSpawnFails (manual/yolo). 'scheduled' mode and configurable delays are not implemented ('scheduled' is migrated to manual) and thus untested (audit 2026-07-23).

TestCircuitBreaker_RecordFailureAndTrip and TestCircuitBreaker_CooldownExpiry cover breaker trip/cooldown; settings TestNormalizeIntFields clamps MaxQueueDepth / CircuitBreakerThreshold / CircuitBreakerCooldownMinutes (configurable caps/breakers).
